events.title: Events
events.description: Every event of the division, drafts and past ones included: its settings, its description, its airports with their capacity, and publishing, cancelling or deleting it.
events.readOnly: You can read this event: changing it is for whoever writes the events.

publish.problems: Before it can be published, it still needs:
publish.saveFirst: Save the settings first: «Publish» publishes the event as it is saved.

delete.title: Delete this event?
delete.description: The event, its airports, its routes and its slots are deleted for good. An event somebody took part in cannot be deleted: cancel it instead.

body.unsaved: The description has changes that are not saved.

hints.kind: A kind of the events, as their settings list them: every kind of the calendar while they list none. Choosing it sets the switches below to what the settings say of that kind; change them as this event needs.
hints.publicSlots: Slots the staff prepares, each with its flight, which a pilot books.
hints.privateSlots: Slots generated from the capacity of each airport, for the flight a pilot chooses.
hints.wholeDivision: The event is about every airport and position of the division, as an online day is: it has no airports of its own.
hints.externalUrl: For an event of the network or of another division: their page about it.
hints.visibleFromUtc: Leave it empty to show the event as soon as it is published.
hints.bookingOpensAtUtc: From when pilots book; each slot closes at its own off block time. Leave it empty for an event without slots.

cancel.title: Cancel the event
cancel.description: The event stays on its page until its end, marked as cancelled, with the note below.

hints.note: Shown on the page of the event, in every language of the division.

hints.maxMovementsPerHour: The capacity of the airport, as arrivals and departures together. Leave it empty to give arrivals and departures apart.
hints.maxArrivalsPerHour: With the departures, instead of the movements.

delete.title: Delete this airport?
delete.description: The airport is taken out of the event.

hints.departureIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.arrivalIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.route: The route to file, as a pilot writes it in the flight plan.
hints.remarks: What a pilot should know about it. The page of the event shows it to everybody: written in one language, it is written in every language of the division. Leave it empty for none.

delete.title: Delete this route?
delete.description: The route is taken out of the event and off its page.

hints.callsign: Letters and digits: the callsign the pilot connects with.
hints.mainAircraftType: The aircraft type the slot is for, one the hub knows, by its ICAO code: A320.
hints.otherAircraftTypes: The other aircraft types the slot admits, separated by /: A20N/A321. Leave it empty for the main type alone.
hints.departureIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows. A slot leaves from an airport of the event, or arrives at one.
hints.arrivalIcao: The ICAO code of an airport the hub knows.
hints.offBlockUtc: The estimated off block time, in UTC.
hints.onBlockUtc: The estimated in block time, in UTC.
hints.stand: Leave it empty while the stand is not decided.
hints.rotationCode: Any code: the legs of one rotation share it. Leave it empty for a slot alone.
hints.rotationLeg: The place of the leg in its rotation, from 1. Left empty, the first leg of a new rotation is the first.

delete.title: Delete this slot?
delete.description: The slot is taken out of the event and off its page. A booked slot is not deleted: take its booking away first.

deleteFree.title: Delete every free slot?
deleteFree.description: Every slot of this event that nobody booked is deleted, public and private. A booked one stays.

load.title: Paste or load the slots
load.description: The public slots of the event from a table copied from a spreadsheet, or from a CSV file: all of it, or nothing.
load.help: The first row is the header, with these names, in any order; rotation and leg can be left out, and a column the hub does not know is left alone:
load.formats: Times are in UTC, written 2026-10-17 14:30; a slot's time at the airport of the event is within six hours of the event. Aircraft types are separated by /, as A320/A20N: the first is the main one, the others are admitted too. The legs of a rotation share its code; without their places (leg), they take them from their times.
load.refused: Nothing was loaded. Correct these and load the table again:

hints.text: The rows copied from the spreadsheet, the header first, or the text of the CSV file chosen above.
hints.mode: A booked slot is never replaced.

mode.ReplaceFree: Replace the free ones with these

public.title: Events
public.description: The events of the division still to come and the ones in progress, in UTC and in the division's own time.
public.none: No event to come for now.
public.noneHere: No event of this kind at this airport.
public.calendarEmpty: No event in this stretch of the calendar.
public.backOffice: Open it in the back office

staffOnly.Draft: Only the staff of the events sees this page: the event is a draft, and nobody else sees it until it is published.
staffOnly.NotSeenYet: For now only the staff of the events sees this page: the event is published, and the others see it from the moment written in «Seen from».
staffOnly.Over: Only the staff of the events sees this page: the event is over, and the site keeps no archive.

public.rotationHint: This flight is part of a rotation, open it for more details

tokenAudiences.bookings: Reading the bookings of the events (a gate manager)

hints.kinds: The words of the calendar, as the calendar's block takes them. None, every kind.
hints.limit: Zero shows as many as one list holds: the fifty soonest.

settings.title: Events settings
settings.description: What the events department changes without a release: what each kind of event switches on, the distance between two bookings of a pilot, how long the pilots' bookings are kept, the reminder.

fields.kindPresets: What each kind of event switches on
fields.bookingGapMinutes: Minutes between two bookings of the same pilot
fields.pilotRetentionMonths: Months the pilots' bookings are kept after an event
fields.reminderLeadHours: Hours before the off block time the reminder is sent

hints.kindPresets: The kinds an event chooses from, each with the switches a new event of that kind starts with; the staff can still change them on the event. The kinds are the words of the calendar. No row at all: an event chooses from every kind of the calendar, with every switch off. A kind with every switch off still needs its row to be chosen.
hints.bookingGapMinutes: Two bookings of one pilot in the same event are at least this far apart, one way or the other, so that one flight can end before the next starts.
hints.pilotRetentionMonths: After this many months from the end of an event, the bookings and the reports of support of its pilots are deleted.
hints.reminderLeadHours: The pilot receives the reminder of a booking this many hours before its off block time.

eventCancelled.title: Cancelled events
eventCancelled.description: An email when an event you booked a slot of, have a shift in or registered for is cancelled, with the reason.

eventChanged.title: Events whose times change
eventChanged.description: An email when the times of an event you booked a slot of, have a shift in or registered for change.

bookingRemoved.title: Bookings taken away
bookingRemoved.description: An email when the staff of the events take a booking of yours away, with the reason.

bookingChanged.title: Booked flights corrected
bookingChanged.description: An email when the staff of the events correct the flight of a slot you booked: its callsign, times, airports or aircraft types.

eventCancelled.subject: [Events] Cancelled: {{title}}

eventChanged.subject: [Events] New times: {{title}}
eventChanged.body:
The times of {{title}} have changed: it now runs from {{starts}} to {{ends}}, in UTC. Check that your bookings still suit you.

The event: {{url}}

---
You can switch these emails off from your profile page.

bookingRemoved.subject: [Events] Booking taken away: {{callsign}}, {{title}}

bookingChanged.subject: [Events] Your booked flight changed: {{callsign}}, {{title}}
bookingChanged.body:
The staff of the events have corrected the flight you booked in {{title}}. It is now {{callsign}}, {{departure}} to {{arrival}}, off block {{offBlock}} UTC, on block {{onBlock}} UTC, for {{types}}.

Your booking stays, with your {{aircraft}}. If it no longer suits you, you can withdraw it until its off block.

The event: {{url}}

---
You can switch these emails off from your profile page.

errors.calendarKindUnknown: This is no longer a kind of the calendar: take the row out.
errors.kindTwice: This kind has more than one row.
errors.kindNotOfEvents: This is not a kind of the events: their settings list the kinds an event chooses from.
errors.endsBeforeItStarts: The event ends before it starts.
errors.visibilityChoice: An event is seen by everybody or by the members.
errors.wholeDivisionHasAirports: This event has airports of its own: take them out before making it about the whole division.
errors.wholeDivisionHasNoAirports: An event about the whole division has no airports of its own.
errors.airportUnknown: The hub does not know this airport.
errors.airportTwice: This airport is already in the event.
errors.routeToItself: A route goes from one airport to another: this is the one it leaves.
errors.capacityEitherOr: Give the movements, or the arrivals and the departures: not both.
errors.eventOver: This event is over: it cannot be cancelled any more.
errors.seenAfterItStarts: The event would be seen only after it starts.
errors.bookingBeforeItIsSeen: The bookings would open before the event is seen.
errors.bookingAfterItStarts: The bookings would open after the event starts.
errors.bookingOpensRequired: An event with slots needs the moment its bookings open.
errors.slotsNeedAirports: An event with slots needs at least one airport of its own.
errors.externalUrlRequired: An event organised by others needs the link to their page.
errors.hasPublicSlots: This event has public slots: delete them before switching the public slots off.
errors.airportHasSlots: Some slots are at this airport: delete them first.
errors.noPublicSlots: This event has no public slots: switch them on in its settings first.
errors.sheetColumnMissing: The header has no such column.
errors.sheetColumnTwice: The header has this column twice.
errors.sheetEmpty: The table has its header and no rows.
errors.sheetTooLong: The table has more rows than one load takes: at most a thousand.
errors.callsignFormat: A callsign is letters and digits, with no spaces.
errors.aircraftFormat: Aircraft types are ICAO codes of two to four letters or digits, separated by /.
errors.aircraftUnknown: The hub does not know one of these aircraft types.
errors.slotToItself: A flight goes from one airport to another: this is the one it leaves.
errors.instantFormat: A time is written in UTC, as 2026-10-17 14:30.
errors.onBlockBeforeOffBlock: The on block is not after the off block.
errors.legRange: The place of a leg is a whole number from 1 to 99.
errors.legWithoutRotation: A leg needs the code of its rotation.
errors.legMissing: Other legs of this rotation have their place: write this one's too.
errors.legTwice: Another leg of this rotation has this place.
errors.chainBroken: This leg does not leave from where the one before it in the rotation arrives.
errors.chainOrder: This leg leaves before the one before it in the rotation.
errors.chainTooClose: This leg leaves too soon after the one before it arrives: less than the minutes between two bookings of a pilot.
errors.slotAwayFromEvent: Neither airport of this flight is one of the event: a slot leaves from one, or arrives at one.
errors.slotOutsideWindow: This slot falls outside its event: its time at the airport of the event is more than six hours before the event starts or after it ends.
errors.slotTwice: The event already has a slot with this callsign at this off block time.
errors.slotNotPublic: A private slot is not corrected as a flight.
errors.exportDraft: This event is a draft: it is exported once it is published.
errors.bookingsContract: Say which version of the contract the program speaks, in the Hub-Bookings-Contract header.
errors.bookingPrivateSlot: A private slot is booked from its own form, with the flight you fly.
errors.slotNotInRotation: This slot is not a leg of a rotation.
errors.bookingCancelledEvent: This event is cancelled: its slots are booked no more.
errors.bookingNotOpen: The bookings of this event are not open yet.
errors.slotClosed: This slot is closed: its off block time has passed.
errors.slotJustTaken: Slot just taken by another pilot.
errors.bookingTryAgain: Too many bookings in the same instant: nothing was booked. Try again.
errors.bookingIncompatible: Too close to another of your bookings in this event: there are fewer minutes than the event asks between the end of one and the start of the other.
errors.aircraftNotAllowed: This slot does not allow this aircraft type.
errors.slotGone: This slot is no longer in the event.
errors.slotBooked: A pilot booked this slot: take the booking away before deleting it.
errors.eventHasBookings: Pilots booked slots of this event: it cannot be deleted. Cancel it instead.
